description: This file defines an interface named NestedSetInterface within the OrangeHRM project, outlining methods for managing nested set tree structures, including getter and setter methods for left, right, and level properties, and associations with NodeInterface.

classes.name: NestedSetInterface
classes.description: An interface that specifies methods for accessing and modifying nested set tree node properties such as left, right, level, and associated node.

methods.name: getLft
methods.description: Returns the left position of the node in the nested set, or null if not set.

methods.name: setLft
methods.description: Sets the left position of the node in the nested set.

methods.name: getRgt
methods.description: Returns the right position of the node in the nested set, or null if not set.

methods.name: setRgt
methods.description: Sets the right position of the node in the nested set.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Returns the level (depth) of the node within the nested set.

methods.name: setLevel
methods.description: Sets the level (depth) of the node within the nested set.

methods.name: setNode
methods.description: Associates a NodeInterface instance with this nested set node.
